hooks.command: d=$(find CLAUDE.md docs/src/AI -type f -printf '%T@\n' 2>/dev/null | sort -rn | head -1); d=${d%.*}; [ -z "$d" ] && exit 0; find src -type f -name '*.py' -newermt "@$d" 2>/dev/null | grep -q . && echo '{"systemMessage":"Docs may be stale: a src/ file changed more recently than any doc. Update the matching docs/src/AI reference + status.md so the session stays compaction-safe."}' || true
